text:
Rae Kim: SummitCorp reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final sign-off on steady vs burst carve, autoscale windows, and whether to exclude analytics endpoints from burst. Ping @DevOps.
DevOps: From telemetry they reserved 40k tokens/min. Recommend baseline 30k (75%) + 10k burst for first 48h. Autoscale: aggressive scale-up window=20s, cooldown=60s during warmup. Enable 15m KV-prefix priming pre-run.
Morgan (CSM): Confirmed with Summit ops 1 they accept 25% buffer for 48h. Billing agreed to tag buffer as "bring-up" and not count as overage for that window. They requested daily 15-min morning check-ins and a short enablement walkthrough after first run.
DevOps: I'll run a two-phase soak tonight: (A) 15m prefix priming, (B) 12m steady at 30k, (C) 2m controlled spike to 41k. Including KV priming + cold-cache checks. k6 snippet below for the spike job.
DevOps: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-7b', prompt:'warmup test'}), { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST' } });
}
```
ops-bot: Job queued by DevOps: job_id=summit-warm-101, start=2024-06-12T17:00:00Z, runner=k6-3.3
Jamie (QA): Quick note 1 cache hit-rate observed ~72% pre-priming -> ~93% after 10m priming in similar runs. Expect p95 improvement post-priming.
ops-bot: Run completed: peak=41k rps (35s spike), avg=34k, errors=0.4% (mostly 429 throttles on analytics paths), p95=210ms. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/jobs/summit-warm-101/logs
Rae Kim: Thanks 1 Action items recap: (1) set autoscale windows per DevOps (20s up / 60s cooldown), (2) enable soft-throttle for /analytics/* and /batch/* during spikes, (3) tag metrics with "bringup:SummitCorp", (4) daily health digest to Summit ops. Assigning @DevOps + @Morgan (CSM).
Morgan (CSM): Invite sent for morning checks and 20-min walkthrough. Posted customer feedback form: https://forms.gle/summit-warmup-feedback
Rae Kim: Reconvene 48h after go-live for post-mortem and renewal readiness summary. :white_check_mark:
